issues.title: Execute manual Users & Access UAT across six seeded roles and tenant boundaries
issues.acceptance:
## Scope / observation (2026-10-19)

User manually reached `/settings/users` as Olympus Tenant Admin. Screenshot shows Olympus ACTIVE, current membership ACTIVE, four Olympus member entries, verified state, Tenant Admin/Security Analyst/Developer/Viewer role badges, member search, Add Existing Member, Invite New User and audit panels. **Visual display is not proof that controls work.**

## Acceptance / test matrix

* Use six separate synthetic local identities (Admin, Analyst, Developer, Viewer, foreign tenant, Platform) via private `~/.sbom-greenfield-uuid/users.json`. Never put passwords into Linear or logs.
* Validate directory search, existing member addition, invitation via Mailpit, duplicate detection, role changes, membership/account state, audit, validation/error handling.
* Confirm UI visibility AND server-side 401/403/404 for prohibited actions, revoked permissions, foreign-tenant isolation and tenant context switching.
* Preserve four seeded Olympus accounts and foreign/platform accounts; mutation tests use disposable records.
* Record test IDs, expected/actual, sanitized screenshots/API status and reproducible failures; keep manual UAT pending until human verification, despite reported 13 browser auth regressions.
* Expand overall UAT via <issue id="a0d63c40-cd1a-4cd1-8e70-9aa8ee93226b" href="https://linear.app/sbom-analyzer/issue/SBO-55/build-and-execute-full-browser-e2e-acceptance-on-isolated-ubuntu-test">SBO-55</issue>, not duplicate every module requirement.

issues.title: UAT-DEF-003: VEX investigation detail/decision response 500 after persisted mutation
issues.acceptance:
## Confirmed High-severity UAT defect (2026-10-19)

Local evidence only: `docs/uat/SBOM_ANALYZER_FULL_UAT_REPORT.md` (2026-10-19, 485 cases, UAT sign-off WITHHELD). Relative evidence paths below are in `docs/uat/evidence/2026-10-19/` in user's Mac checkout; no committed remote artifact verified. No fixes applied by QA. Preserve seeded identities; use disposable fixtures. 
**Reproduce:** Olympus Admin uploads known CycloneDX fixture, runs OSV, GET `/api/vex/investigations/42`: list 200, detail 500. Versioned decision mutation persists (version moves 1→3) but API returns 500; retry with original version also 500 instead of expected 409. Log `ResponseValidationError`.
**Root cause diagnosed read-only:** `analyzer_evidence.match_confidence` is a float, while `AnalyzerEvidenceSection.match_confidence` requires `str | None`. Reused detail serializer breaks GET, mutation success payload, conflict response. Treat as **one root defect** not three issues.
**Evidence IDs:** UAT-VEX-DETAIL, UAT-VEX-DECISION, UAT-VEX-STALE; request IDs `96f44f3529bf`, `c6605cd1fc81`; `vex-detail-validation.json`, `diagnose-vex-detail.py`.
**Fix/acceptance:** define type-correct API contract; stop 5xx serialization, including conflicts; verify state once per mutation, no duplicate effects or unintended retries, exact 200/409/403/404 behavior, concurrent/versioned decisions, assignment and browser details; rerun impacted BLOCKED UAT-VEX-DECISION-UI and assigned Developer cases. **Never auto-retry an HTTP 500 mutation without checking persisted state.** Do not consider production acceptable until fixed/retested.

issues.title: UAT-DEF-006: Dashboard hierarchy UUID selection silently resets to all projects
issues.acceptance:
## Confirmed High-severity UUID migration regression (2026-10-19)

Local evidence only: `docs/uat/SBOM_ANALYZER_FULL_UAT_REPORT.md` (2026-10-19, 485 cases, UAT sign-off WITHHELD). Relative evidence paths below are in `docs/uat/evidence/2026-10-19/` in user's Mac checkout; no committed remote artifact verified. No fixes applied by QA. Preserve seeded identities; use disposable fixtures. 
**Reproduce:** Olympus Admin Dashboard → Project filter → UAT project with UUID. URL changes to `?project=d4828e7c-e71c-40f7-bb6c-dde0f4d48d09` but selection reverts to All projects; scoped summary request never fires and reload loses selection. Direct backend `project_id=<UUID>` returns correctly scoped metrics.
**Root cause:** `frontend/src/lib/dashboardScopeUrl.ts::positiveId` calls `Number(raw)`, only accepts positive integers. `parseDashboardScope` drops UUID/project then dependent Application/SBOM scope. It risks presenting tenant-wide counts as selected-project counts.
**Evidence:** UAT-DASHBOARD-FILTER-UI, UAT-DASHBOARD-FILTER-REFRESH, `UAT-dashboard-filter-incomplete.png`.
**Fix/acceptance:** UUIDv4 public-ID parser throughout URL serialization/state and dependent hierarchy; update obsolete integer-only tests; exercise all Project→Application→SBOM filters, deep-link, reload, tenant switch, invalid/stale UUID, unauthorized scope, actual backend requests and metric totals. Unblock UAT-DASHBOARD-DEPENDENT-FILTERS and <issue id="d177a7d2-a799-4582-83c7-a2041760ba56" href="https://linear.app/sbom-analyzer/issue/SBO-26/reconcile-tenant-project-product-sbom-filters-severity-and-drilldowns">SBO-26</issue> acceptance.

issues.title: UAT-DEF-001: Add Existing Member candidate popup intercepts Cancel button
issues.acceptance:
## Confirmed Medium UAT UI defect (2026-10-19)

Local evidence only: `docs/uat/SBOM_ANALYZER_FULL_UAT_REPORT.md` (2026-10-19, 485 cases, UAT sign-off WITHHELD). Relative evidence paths below are in `docs/uat/evidence/2026-10-19/` in user's Mac checkout; no committed remote artifact verified. No fixes applied by QA. Preserve seeded identities; use disposable fixtures. 
**Reproduce:** Olympus Admin → Users & Access → Add Existing Member → search already-present admin → 'No eligible users found for this tenant' → click Cancel. Popup overlays Cancel; Playwright click times out with pointer interception. Escape can dismiss. Candidate backend returns correct 200/empty data.
**Root cause:** `UserSearchCombobox.tsx` results absolute `top-full z-50` overlaps footer in `TenantUsersAccess.tsx`; popup lacks collision/reserved-space handling.
**Evidence:** UAT-USER-014, `UAT-USER-014-cancel-overlap.png`, pointer diagnostics.
**Acceptance:** Cancel remains clickable with empty/populated/error candidates at desktop/mobile; keyboard/Escape focus, dialog behavior and no candidate lookup regression; attach retest evidence.

issues.title: UAT-DEF-002: Decide global IAM account search privacy vs cross-tenant no-enumeration
issues.acceptance:
## Medium security/product acceptance-policy gap (2026-10-19)

Local evidence only: `docs/uat/SBOM_ANALYZER_FULL_UAT_REPORT.md` (2026-10-19, 485 cases, UAT sign-off WITHHELD). Relative evidence paths below are in `docs/uat/evidence/2026-10-19/` in user's Mac checkout; no committed remote artifact verified. No fixes applied by QA. Preserve seeded identities; use disposable fixtures. 
**Observed:** Isolation Control Tenant Admin (no Olympus membership) uses own-tenant `/api/tenants/{tenant_uuid}/user-candidates?q=olympus`. HTTP 200 returns five global eligible IAM accounts (four Olympus and Platform), including email/display name/account status. Implemented `tenant:user:invite` permission intentionally allows global candidate discovery; Olympus member-directory and business-resource isolation remain enforced. **Do not label this confirmed cross-tenant business-data breach.**
**Evidence:** UAT-ISOLATION-GLOBAL-CANDIDATES, `app/routers/tenants.py::search_tenant_user_candidates`, `direct-api-cases.json`.
**Decision required:** Product + security owner explicitly choose (a) accept documented global directory discovery with exposure/consent/audit/rate controls, or (b) exact-email/minimal-fields or scoped invitation flow. Define acceptance criteria before any code change.
**Acceptance:** written approved policy, threat-model/privacy review, tenant enumeration/rate limits, safe error responses, client UX, direct API tests; update UAT-DEF-002 disposition. No approval implied by issue creation.

issues.title: UAT-DEF-005: Tenant Admin sees KEV catalog sync but API requires Platform Admin
issues.acceptance:
## Confirmed Medium permission/UI mismatch (2026-10-19)

Local evidence only: `docs/uat/SBOM_ANALYZER_FULL_UAT_REPORT.md` (2026-10-19, 485 cases, UAT sign-off WITHHELD). Relative evidence paths below are in `docs/uat/evidence/2026-10-19/` in user's Mac checkout; no committed remote artifact verified. No fixes applied by QA. Preserve seeded identities; use disposable fixtures. 
**Reproduce:** Olympus Tenant Admin opens CISA KEV → Sync KEV Catalog enabled → click → HTTP 403 (`IAM_TENANT_SELECTION_REQUIRED`). Frontend uses `tenant:settings:update` gate; route and service require Platform authority. Valid tenant header still denied. Server correctly prevented tenant from updating global catalog.
**Evidence:** UAT-KEV-SYNC-UI, request ID `7511a11888d2`, `UAT-kev-admin-sync-denied.png`. Platform Admin dry-ish sync with `prune_stale=false` fetched real 1748 catalog entries, upserted 0.
**Acceptance:** gate control using matching platform permission, locate in Platform controls or explain unavailable state; retain global server enforcement; direct API tenant 403, Platform allowed, Viewer denied; verify UI disabled/hidden behavior and proper errors.

**Module placement:** CISA KEV is global vulnerability intelligence and belongs in <project id="46a321c4-7f3a-47c9-8c53-53f98a41eb28" href="https://linear.app/sbom-analyzer/project/sbom-analyzer-vulnerability-analysis-and-vex-3b1abb71901d">SBOM Analyzer — Vulnerability Analysis & VEX</project>; Dashboard/UI synchronization and IAM authorization remain related acceptance contexts. Existing global API policy must not be weakened to match the mistaken UI gate.

issues.title: UAT-DEF-007: Advisor policy version-history serialization incorrectly resolves SBOM source IDs
issues.acceptance:
## Confirmed Medium UAT defect (2026-10-19)

Local evidence only: `docs/uat/SBOM_ANALYZER_FULL_UAT_REPORT.md` (2026-10-19, 485 cases, UAT sign-off WITHHELD). Relative evidence paths below are in `docs/uat/evidence/2026-10-19/` in user's Mac checkout; no committed remote artifact verified. No fixes applied by QA. Preserve seeded identities; use disposable fixtures. 
**Reproduce:** disposable tenant Admin publishes DISABLED trust/accepted-risk/scoring policy (201), then GET `/api/component-advisor/policies/{kind}/versions`; nonempty history HTTP 500 `Unresolvable public resource reference`. Stale policy publish correctly produces 409.
**Root diagnosis:** `app/public_api.py` globally interprets any path segment `versions` as `sbom_source`, then tries to rewrite policy-specific integer version IDs as SBOM public IDs. No same-tenant SBOM collision existed in test. **Potential incorrect-ID collision is UNTESTED, not confirmed disclosure.**
**Evidence:** UAT-POLICY-HISTORY-trust, -accepted-risk, -scoring, `policy-history-correlated-log.txt`, `policy-history-diagnosis.json`.
**Acceptance:** typed, explicit policy version identity contract and route-specific converter; cover empty/nonempty histories, all three policy kinds, platform/tenant scope, version collision, role and isolation, no 500 and correct returned IDs; keep release-scope decision separate (<issue id="fccc91ae-2e0d-4921-812f-05871a4f26cb" href="https://linear.app/sbom-analyzer/issue/SBO-40/reconcile-sbo-519-recommendation-stories-to-fr-sca-001024">SBO-40</issue>/41).
